nodes.label: Webpage Component Previews
nodes.rationale: Reuses the viewer-only batch resolver with bounded blocks and exact scope, without granting page or root access.

nodes.label: Timeline Component Bindings

nodes.label: API Endpoints and Capabilities Feature Map
Password Manager
nodes.rationale: Secret output stays in the controlled entry draft, and the password client avoids shared diagnostics and automatic origin fallback so decrypted fields do not enter shared client history or cache.

nodes.label: iOS TestFlight Delivery
nodes.rationale: Origin fallback is disallowed for the native release script.

nodes.label: Mapbox Provider Integration
nodes.rationale: Provider destinations are fixed and responses are redacted; the public SDK is staged as same-origin assets to avoid allowing a remote Mapbox script or eval.

nodes.label: Storage Readiness and Recovery
nodes.rationale: The dispatcher records allowlisted storage failure codes without logging response bodies.

nodes.label: Connections Catalog and Management
nodes.rationale: Owner-private encrypted grants replace shared tokens, and OAuth app configuration is scoped to the exact origin and environment.

nodes.label: Environment Gateway and Index Readiness
nodes.rationale: Durable index readiness is coordinated without blocking read-only authentication.

nodes.label: Public Social Metadata
nodes.rationale: Anonymous projections use explicit allowlists, refuse remote URLs, avoid resolving caller identity, and return generic metadata for private or missing content.

nodes.label: Named Connections Management
nodes.rationale: The fixed operation and exact actor, origin, and connection checks protect named connection actions; token envelopes never cross the response boundary.

nodes.label: Write-Only Credential Handoff
nodes.rationale: Credential import responses expose only destination metadata, status, and receipts; generic origin fallback and background dispatch are refused.

nodes.label: Dynamic Map Workspaces
nodes.rationale: Map source authorization and cursor paths remain in use, and a failed refresh clears only the affected points layer.

nodes.label: Shared-Content Request Transport
nodes.rationale: The scoped reader checks authorization and rate limits before streaming UTF-8 decoding; upload completion enumerates parts server-side, and presigning paginates them.

nodes.label: Reviewed Creation Projections and Execution Admission
nodes.rationale: Creation holds are retained in browse and resolve projections so server, browser, shared, and child execution can refuse held content.

nodes.label: Client Discovery Failure Classification
nodes.rationale: Temporary discovery failures may retain a same-scope readable template only while execution remains unverified and inert.
